lesson_title: MCP Architecture
source_note: Host/Client/Server 架构
claim_to_verify: Host/Client/Server 架构
verified_claim: MCP separates Host, Client and Server roles: the Host owns the user-facing application and trust policy, the Client handles protocol communication, and the Server exposes tools/resources/prompts.
reviewer_note: Architecture diagram supports the logical roles; a Client SDK object or TCP connection is not the same as a protocol-level session.

lesson_title: MCP Architecture

reviewer_note: Transport success or a JSON-RPC result does not prove the requested business postcondition or caller authorization.

lesson_title: MCP Architecture

verified_claim: The 2026-07-28 MCP revision is a stateless protocol core: it removes initialize/initialized and protocol-level Mcp-Session-Id; each request carries version and client capabilities in _meta.
reviewer_note: The release blog and versioned specification identify this as a breaking protocol revision; legacy versions retain the older handshake.

lesson_title: MCP Architecture

claim_to_verify: modern/legacy era、server/discover 与兼容回退
verified_claim: The modern protocol uses per-request version metadata; server/discover is a Server method and clients may call it before other operations; version errors identify supported versions.
reviewer_note: clientInfo is optional self-reported metadata, not a security signal. The server method is required; the client call is optional.

reviewer_note: Modern list-change notifications are delivered through subscriptions/listen; tool metadata and descriptions are untrusted input.

lesson_title: MCP Server Tools Specification 2026-07-28

reviewer_note: Resource URI is not an authorization grant; enforce per-resource ACL and tenant scope.

lesson_title: MCP Server Tools Specification 2026-07-28

reviewer_note: Prompt templates are not trusted security policy; user selection and server-side authorization remain separate.

reviewer_note: input_required MRTR results and inputResponses/requestState retries are not cacheable. cacheScope does not replace ACL.

verified_claim: RFC 9110 defines HTTP semantics, methods, status codes, fields and request/response behavior used by the Streamable HTTP binding.
reviewer_note: The MCP binding adds protocol-specific headers and JSON-RPC semantics; generic HTTP success is not MCP business success.

lesson_title: MCP Python SDK: Running Your Server
source_note: POST、无协议会话、SSE response、headers 与 subscriptions/listen
claim_to_verify: POST、无协议会话、SSE response、headers 与 subscriptions/listen
verified_claim: Modern Streamable HTTP sends each JSON-RPC request as an independent POST, returns JSON or request-scoped SSE, removes GET/DELETE /mcp stream and session IDs, and uses subscriptions/listen for long-lived change notifications.
reviewer_note: POST requires MCP-Protocol-Version and Mcp-Method; tools/call, resources/read and prompts/get also require Mcp-Name; validate headers against the body and advertise JSON/SSE Accept.

lesson_title: MCP Python SDK: Running Your Server
source_note: InputRequiredResult、requestState 完整性/重放防护、支持方法和新 JSON-RPC id
claim_to_verify: InputRequiredResult、requestState 完整性/重放防护、支持方法和新 JSON-RPC id
verified_claim: MRTR returns InputRequiredResult with inputRequests and/or requestState for prompts/get, resources/read or tools/call; client answers and retries the original request using a new JSON-RPC id.
reviewer_note: requestState is opaque and must be echoed unchanged; server must protect integrity, bind principal/expiry/request digest and prevent replay across requests.
